description: The virtual mast's user name when it was dropped from its level (Mast 16L). Listed once. It names no mast of masts.csv any more.

Its VirtualSignalMast system name (IF$vsm:basic:one-low($1016)). The ordinal in the brackets stays taken, so no new virtual mast reuses it (hartlib.hand_lists.read_retired_masts, level_masts.virtual_ordinal); no two rows share an ordinal.
The date it was dropped, YYYY-MM-DD.
Why it was dropped, and whether it comes back when a parked feature returns.
